dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, you never speak in class. Is everything OK?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, juː ˈnɛvər ˈspiːk ɪn ˈklæs. ɪz ˈɛvriθɪŋ oʊˈkeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, but it's hard for me to speak in front of everyone.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, bʌt ɪts ˈhɑːrd fər miː tə ˈspiːk ɪn ˈfrʌnt əv ˈɛvriwʌn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: In Thai schools, students usually listen and take notes. It isn't easy for us to participate.
dialogue.reading: ɪn ˈtaɪ ˈskuːlz, ˈstuːdənts ˈjuːʒuəli ˈlɪsən ənd ˈteɪk ˈnoʊts. ɪt ˈɪzənt ˈiːzi fər ʌs tə pɑːrˈtɪsəpeɪt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I understand. But in my class, it's important for everyone to participate.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˌʌndərˈstænd. bʌt ɪn maɪ ˈklæs, ɪts ɪmˈpɔːrtənt fər ˈɛvriwʌn tə pɑːrˈtɪsəpeɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I know. Sometimes I want to raise my hand, but I'm afraid of making mistakes.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ. ˈsʌmtaɪmz aɪ ˈwɑːnt tə ˈreɪz maɪ ˈhænd, bʌt aɪm əˈfreɪd əv ˈmeɪkɪŋ mɪˈsteɪks.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Mistakes are fine. It's OK for students to make mistakes. That's how we learn.
dialogue.reading: mɪˈsteɪks ər ˈfaɪn. ɪts oʊˈkeɪ fər ˈstuːdənts tə ˈmeɪk mɪˈsteɪks. ðæts ˈhaʊ wiː ˈlɜːrn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Also, it's hard for me to concentrate when the class discusses things very fast.
dialogue.reading: ˈɔːlsoʊ, ɪts ˈhɑːrd fər miː tə ˈkɑːnsəntreɪt wɛn ðə ˈklæs dɪˈskʌsɪz ˈθɪŋz ˈvɛri ˈfæst.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Then let's try something. Before we discuss a question, I'll give everyone five minutes to think.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn ˈlɛts ˈtraɪ ˈsʌmθɪŋ. bɪˈfɔːr wiː dɪˈskʌs ə ˈkwɛstʃən, aɪl ˈɡɪv ˈɛvriwʌn ˈfaɪv ˈmɪnɪts tə ˈθɪŋk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That will help. It's easier for me to talk when I'm prepared.
dialogue.reading: ðæt wɪl ˈhɛlp. ɪts ˈiːziər fər miː tə ˈtɔːk wɛn aɪm prɪˈpɛrd.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Good. And please pay attention to the questions. Next time, I'll ask you first!
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd. ənd ˈpliːz ˈpeɪ əˈtɛnʃən tə ðə ˈkwɛstʃənz. ˈnɛkst ˈtaɪm, aɪl ˈæsk juː ˈfɜːrst!
